video.audioIntent: five tactile semantic events from traceable local SFX

materialSystem.name: multi-layer tactile cardstock
mechanisms: five to eleven stacked thickness layers
top-edge highlight and darker exposed paper edge
dynamic contact shadow tied to landing progress
multi-scale paper fiber and halftone texture

worlds.semanticPurpose: 原始信号落在桌面后，经实体分流轮拆成镜头、证据、关系三条视觉任务，并逐路完成输出复核
worlds.composition: 俯拍工作台；左侧输入卷带、中央厚纸分流轮、右侧三枚错位任务牌，缓慢退镜展示整体因果
layers: task plaques, moving beads and completion ring
assemblySteps: thick base sheet lands on desk
signal ribbon slides from left
splitter wheel is pressed into place
three cardstock routes draw outward
task plaques land sequentially
three beads travel to their outputs
completion ring presses around the mechanism while three output checks complete before handoff

worlds.semanticPurpose: 摄影半调剪纸、材料卡、地图与命题先落位，红线随后建立来源关系并形成闭合
worlds.composition: 斜视墙面向左后方退深；半调摄影剪纸居左、待证命题居中、材料卡居右，前景证据条遮挡下沿
layers: dark wall and thick evidence board
photo cutout, source notes, map and claim
pins, red threads, foreground strip and verdict stamp
assemblySteps: evidence wall slides in at an angle
halftone photo cutout lands
two source documents are pinned
map and central proposition arrive
pins press at relationship endpoints
red threads draw in three causal passes
foreground strip and relationship stamp close the board while an audit token traverses the closed evidence chain

worlds.semanticPurpose: 两侧输入进入透视道路和处理拱门，数据包穿过机制后使纸雕城市逐栋升起
worlds.composition: 低机位面对纸雕地台；道路从前景收束至拱门，输入盒位于两侧，城市沿地平线产生前后遮挡
layers: sky, horizon and folding ground plane
input blocks, road and processing arch
moving parcels, multi-face buildings, foreground silhouette and completion card
objectGroups: paper-sculpture city, completion card and output receipts
assemblySteps: ground plane folds open
input blocks rise from the foreground
perspective road grows toward the horizon
processing arch rises
three data parcels traverse the mechanism
five multi-face buildings rise in sequence
completion card presses above the finished system and four output receipts arrive in sequence

transitions.mechanism: red and cream thick paper sheets wipe across the lens while a signal-to-evidence paper label and lower semantic edge remain visible
navy and yellow thick paper sheets wipe backward while an evidence-to-system paper label and lower semantic edge remain visible

world C delivers four semantic output receipts from local 7.35s through 10.07s instead of holding a static city
